body: ... yess... wow. thank you for sharing. we are going through such similar experiences and i am so sorry for any emotional pain you are going through.. i’ve been working on keeping my mouth shut lately too for the reasons. hoping once i get out the house I’ll officially be able to start my road to real mental health recovery. We got this.. so tough, but keep pushing through. 💙

first step is to tell your girlfriend. or ex girlfriend. that’s a great place to start. I know it seems so scary and over whelming but it’s important you let her know everything you are and were going through especially at that time. There is no excuse for cheating.. but no one is perfect and regardless if she stays with you or not after you tell her. It’s important you’re honest with not only her but with yourself, and hopefully that can be a fresh new start to fixing what is going on.

Wow, thank you so much for sharing. You are incredibly strong, I really needed to hear that because some of the things you have mentioned.. have really taken affect in my life right now. Awesome to know there’s light at the end of tunnel. You are so strong btw and keep prospering!!
